dct_description_sm: This GIS dataset depicts the surficial geology of the Chipewyan Lake area (NTS 84A/NW) (GIS data, polygon features). The data were created in geodatabase format and output for public distribution in shapefile format. These data comprise the polygon features of Alberta Geological Survey Map 572, Surficial Geology of the Chipewyan Lake Area (NTS 84A/NW).
dct_title_s: Surficial Geology of the Chipewyan Lake Area (NTS 84A/NW) (GIS data, polygon features)
